## How it works

<h2>Developer integration</h2><p>An integration can open a saved overview using a BCF camera instead of implementing its own navigation controls. The downward orthographic cameras enable 2D panning, with north-up and 30° orientations. A perspective camera restores 3D navigation. These are whole-model views without floor cuts. The page writes camera data with <code>bcf.save()</code>, imports it with <code>viewer.add()</code> and applies it with <code>viewer.selectTopic()</code>.</p><p>Copy this folder and serve it over HTTP, for example <code>python -m http.server 8080</code>. Open <code>http://localhost:8080/</code>; the SDK and sample downloads require internet access.</p>
<p>The page opens the original source bytes with <code>await viewer.IfcAPI</code>, reads native model data, then closes the model and disposes WASM before displaying the source with <code>viewer.add()</code>. See the <a href="https://thatopen.github.io/engine_web-ifc/docs/classes/web-ifc.IfcAPI.html">complete web-ifc API reference</a>.</p>
